title: Cal.com booking subsystem — CodeGraph baseline
scope: Web booking subsystem: public booking and management UI, web HTTP/tRPC booking and slot APIs, availability, booking lifecycle, persistence adapters, and supporting notification/calendar services. API v2, generic UI/auth utilities and provider-specific app-store implementations are outside this boundary. Supporting packages include their indexed files, not just booking-exclusive code.
